stops.note: hard, giving rise to durare (to harden)
to harden thoroughly, to persist stubbornly, from ob- and durare
stops.meaning: to harden thoroughly, to persist stubbornly

stops.note: settled as the English word for someone stubbornly refusing to change their mind
stops.meaning: stubbornly refusing to change one's mind or opinion

current_meaning: stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion, course of action, or feelings
